title: Token resolution logic has no test coverage
reasoning: get_token() encodes a precedence contract (env > .env > config.json) plus an argv override in __main__, with parsing quirks such as quote stripping and regex key matching. The feature metadata lists no tests and the project has no test command, so changes to resolution order, the regex, or quote handling can regress silently.
recommendation: Add unit tests using monkeypatch/tmp_path covering precedence order, .env quote/whitespace stripping, config.json regex matching (including non-matching files), and the argv override.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The project has no test files or test command (commands.test is null), and this feature's tests list is empty.
suggestedRegressionTest: Parametrized tests for get_token() precedence: env wins over .env, .env wins over config.json, malformed files return None, and quoted .env values are stripped.
minimumFixScope: Add a test module for update_bot_button.py get_token()
